items.question: Which topics are explained in the thirtieth and thirty-first chapters?
premises: The nature of mantra and its power are explained in the thirtieth chapter.
The division of the trident and lotus is a topic of the thirty-first chapter.
The explanation of the sky-rabbit, svastika, and others is a topic of the thirty-first chapter.
items.inference: The thirtieth chapter treats mantra and its power, while the thirty-first treats the trident-lotus division and related diagrams.
uncertainties: The exact referents of vyomaśa and svastika in this ritual context are not fully specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: In the thirtieth chapter, the nature of mantra and its power are explained. In the thirty-first, the division of the trident and lotus and the explanation of the sky-rabbit, svastika, and other figures are to be treated.

items.question: What topics are to be explained in detail in the thirty-first and thirty-second chapters?
premises: Certain matters are to be explained in detail in the thirty-first chapter.
The distinctions of quality and principality are topics of the thirty-second chapter.
The own nature and the worship of power are topics of the thirty-second chapter.
items.inference: The thirty-first chapter gives a detailed treatment, and the thirty-second chapter addresses distinctions of quality and principality, own nature, and the worship of power.
uncertainties: The verse compresses the transition between chapters, so the exact boundary of topics is slightly ambiguous.
items.plain_english: These matters are to be explained in detail in the thirty-first chapter. In the thirty-second chapter, the distinctions of quality and principality, the own nature, and the worship of power are set forth.

items.question: Why is the division of parts declared in the full revelation of the seals?
premises: The division of parts is declared in the full revelation of the seals.
From the thirty-two principles and the Lord's teaching onward, the matter is clearly manifest.
Clear manifestation makes the division evident.
items.inference: The division of parts in the seals is declared because, from the thirty-two principles and the Lord's teaching onward, it becomes clearly manifest.
uncertainties: The compound dvātriṃśatattvādīśākhyātprabhṛti may refer to a specific textual or doctrinal sequence that is not fully explicit here.
items.plain_english: Thus the division of parts is declared in the full revelation of the seals, because from the thirty-two principles and the Lord's teaching onward it becomes clearly manifest.

items.question: Why is no further separate enunciation given at this point?
premises: No further division exists at this point.
Therefore no other enunciation is stated here.
The matter is primary and already known, so the sequence of other topics follows.
items.inference: Because no further division exists and the subject is primary and already known, no separate enunciation is given here.
uncertainties: The scope of adhikārāntarakramaḥ could refer to subsequent chapters or to subordinate topics within the same exposition.
items.plain_english: There is no further division here, so no other separate enunciation is given. Because this subject is primary and already known, the sequence of the remaining topics follows.
